card.line: Heshbon was the city of Sihon, king of the Amorites. Israel captured it after Sihon refused them passage, and the tribe of Reuben later rebuilt it.

moments.title: Sihon refuses Israel passage
moments.text: Israel asked Sihon king of Heshbon for peace and safe passage. Sihon refused, because the LORD had made his spirit stubborn so that He might deliver him into Israel's hand.

moments.title: Israel captures Heshbon
moments.text: After Israel defeated Sihon in battle, they captured all the cities of the Amorites and lived in them, including Heshbon and its villages. Heshbon was Sihon's city.

moments.title: Reuben and Gad ask for the land
moments.text: The Reubenites and Gadites had large herds and flocks. They asked Moses for the land the LORD had conquered, including Heshbon, as their own possession.

moments.title: Reubenites rebuild Heshbon
moments.text: Moses gave Sihon's kingdom to Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh. The Reubenites then built up Heshbon and other cities.
